features.name: Mt. Tabor Summit
features.description: The summit is the park's highest destination for city and mountain views, reached by road when open or by steep paved paths, stairs, and trails.

details.positionQuality: Southeast Tabor Summit Drive, Mount Tabor, Portland, Multnomah County, Oregon, 97215, United States
details.imageAlt: Mt. Tabor Summit at Mt. Tabor Park

features.name: Mt. Tabor Reservoirs
features.description: Historic open reservoirs form the visual heart of Mt. Tabor; enjoy them from paths and overlooks but do not enter fenced water infrastructure.

details.positionQuality: Reviewed reservoir overlook area in Mt. Tabor Park

features.name: Mt. Tabor Amphitheater
features.description: The outdoor amphitheater hosts concerts and events; pets are prohibited inside on concert days and event setups can restrict nearby paths.

details.coordinateSource: AuditMap review of the official Mt. Tabor Park map
details.imageAlt: Mt. Tabor Amphitheater at Mt. Tabor Park

features.name: Mt. Tabor Playground
features.description: The accessible playground is reached by a paved path with a moderate slope and sits below the summit among picnic and recreation areas.

details.positionQuality: Reviewed Mt. Tabor accessible playground placement

features.name: Mt. Tabor Dog Off-Leash Area
features.description: The designated off-leash area is the only place for legal off-leash use; leash dogs throughout the rest of the park.

details.positionQuality: Reviewed south-side Mt. Tabor dog off-leash area

features.name: Mt. Tabor Picnic Shelter
features.description: The summit-area picnic shelter is being rebuilt May through August 2026, with the shelter site and two nearby paths closed during construction.

features.name: Mt. Tabor Community Garden
features.description: Mt. Tabor Community Garden is an active allotment garden rather than a general picnic lawn; admire plots without entering or harvesting.

details.positionQuality: Mt. Tabor Community Garden, Mount Tabor, Portland, Multnomah County, Oregon, United States
details.imageAlt: Mt. Tabor Community Garden at Mt. Tabor Park

features.description: The PDX Adult Soapbox Derby uses the park's steep road course for its annual event, bringing road closures, crowds, noise, and limited parking.
